name: The Kahala Resort
insider_take: This legendary oceanfront sanctuary sits on pristine Kahala Beach, where Hollywood royalty and world leaders have escaped the crowds for over 50 years.
whats_special: Home to the only dolphin lagoon at a luxury resort in the US, where you can interact with Atlantic bottlenose dolphins in a private 26,000-square-foot natural habitat. The resort's secluded location offers Diamond Head views while being just 10 minutes from Waikiki's energy.
pro_tip: Book the Dolphin Quest experience in advance - it fills up quickly and offers an unforgettable encounter that's exclusive to Kahala guests and visitors.
dont_miss: Snorkeling right off Kahala Beach to spot Hawaiian green sea turtles, and sunset cocktails at Plumeria Beach House with unobstructed ocean views. The nearby Waialae Country Club hosts the PGA Tour's Sony Open each January.
pros: Secluded luxury location away from Waikiki crowds
Private dolphin lagoon and marine life encounters
Pristine private beach with calm waters
Exceptional dining options including beachfront restaurants
cons: Distance from Waikiki and downtown attractions
